verdict.rationale: Morph is an API service, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no user-facing retention settings, deletion endpoints, or zero-retention option. The only related item is a community quote of the privacy policy's tier-based training terms (the free tier may train on submitted code; the enterprise tier uses it only for the immediate request). That is an adjacent data-use policy, not user control over retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.
